name: allocate_checked_memory_block
description: Allocates a 94-byte cleared memory block, stores a pointer to a field inside it, and runs two lookups on the caller's arguments. If a lookup fails the block is freed and zero is returned; otherwise the block is returned.

name: return_without_action
description: Empty library routine that returns at once without doing any work. It is a no-op entry that other code reaches through a pointer.

name: call_routine_and_return_zero
description: Calls one other library routine, discards its result, and returns zero to the caller.

name: call_with_stepped_offset
description: Calls one other library routine with the second argument increased by a fixed step of 78, and returns without a value.

name: find_string_value_after_equals
description: Walks a NULL-terminated list of strings and returns the text after the equals sign of the first entry that passes the match check. Returns zero if the list ends first.

name: scan_list_for_equals_entry
description: Scans a NULL-terminated list of pointers for an entry that passes the match check and has an equals sign at the matched position, and returns the text after that sign, or zero when the list ends.

name: return_text_after_list_match
description: Walks a NULL-terminated list of strings, calling a match check on each entry, and returns the text after the first equals sign of the entry that passes. Returns zero when the list is exhausted.

name: check_bar_segments_against_text
description: Walks vertical-bar separated segments of a string and returns one when a segment has the length of the target text and the check on its contents passes. Returns zero when no segment matches.

name: check_bar_segments_by_length
description: Walks vertical-bar separated segments of a string, comparing each segment length with a target length and calling a check on the text, and returns one on the first full match or zero at the end.

name: scan_bar_segments_with_check
description: Steps through vertical-bar separated segments of a string, compares each segment length with a target and calls a text check, and returns one on a match or zero when the string runs out.

name: test_bar_segment_text
description: Tests one vertical-bar separated segment at a time, returning one if its length equals the target and the text check passes, or zero when the end of the string is reached.

name: find_bar_segment_match
description: Starts at the beginning of a vertical-bar separated string and searches its segments for one with the target length and a passing text check. Returns one if found, otherwise zero.

name: build_next_copy_name
description: Builds a new name for a copied file in a buffer of at most 30 bytes. If the source name already starts with the word copy, it reads that copy number and advances it; otherwise it writes a copy prefix in front of the name.

name: parse_copy_number_prefix
description: Reads a decimal number that follows a five-character prefix, checks that a fixed three-character marker follows, then calls two routines to finish the work.

name: parse_number_then_finish
description: Reads a run of decimal digits at the current text position and checks that a fixed four-character string follows. Both outcomes call the same two routines to finish.

name: read_copy_number_digits
description: Accumulates decimal digits from the current text position, then checks that the following text matches the copy suffix. Both outcomes call two routines to finish.

name: convert_char_to_digit
description: Returns the numeric value of a character when it is a digit from zero to nine, and minus one for any other character.

name: stub_return_minus_one
description: Returns minus one as a fixed negative result and performs no other work.

name: call_library_entry_no_args
description: Calls one function of an Amiga library through its jump table and returns, passing no arguments and returning no value.

name: call_library_entry_then_return
description: Calls a different function of an Amiga library through its jump table and returns, passing no arguments and returning no value.

name: try_pair_and_release
description: Calls one routine with two arguments and, if it returns a value, passes that value to a second routine. If the second call fails it runs a cleanup routine and returns zero; otherwise it returns the value from the first call.

name: allocate_record_with_defaults
description: Allocates a 96-byte cleared block, stores the value ten in one of its 16-bit fields and in the first word of the caller's buffer, then passes the block to a second routine that fills the buffer. Returns whether the allocation succeeded.

name: return_zero_no_op
description: Does nothing and returns zero.

name: forward_result_if_matching
description: Calls a library function with three arguments and returns its result only when that result equals the fourth argument; otherwise it returns zero.

name: check_library_result_equals_argument
description: Calls one routine with three arguments and returns the result when it equals the fourth argument, otherwise zero. It uses a different library function from its neighbour.

name: return_immediately_no_op
description: Empty routine that returns at once without doing any work.

name: divide_with_quotient_and_remainder
description: Divides a 32-bit value by another, using a bit-by-bit loop when the divisor is large and 16-bit divisions otherwise, and returns the quotient and the remainder together.

name: divide_by_shift_subtract_loop
description: Runs sixteen shift-and-subtract steps that divide a 32-bit dividend by a 16-bit divisor, leaving the quotient and remainder in the working registers.

name: multiply_32_bit_low_product
description: Multiplies two 32-bit values from the working registers using 16-bit partial products and returns the low 32 bits of the product.

name: call_raw_format_function
description: Calls the exec library raw formatting routine through a function pointer kept in the global data, then returns.

name: store_low_byte_at_pointer
description: Stores the low byte of the data register at the address held in the address register, then returns.

name: measure_c_string_length
description: Counts the characters of a zero-terminated string by decrementing a 32-bit counter once per character, and returns the count recovered from that counter. It behaves as a string length routine.

name: find_char_in_c_string
description: Scans a zero-terminated string for a given character and returns a pointer to its first occurrence, or zero if the terminator is reached first.

name: stub_return_zero_value
description: Returns zero and performs no other work.

name: copy_c_string
description: Copies a zero-terminated source string to the destination, including the terminating zero byte.

name: append_c_string
description: Moves to the end of the destination string and copies the zero-terminated source onto it, including its terminator.

name: compare_strings_up_to_limit
description: Compares two strings for at most a given number of characters. It returns zero when they match through the limit or both end together, and one at the first difference.

name: return_one_no_op
description: Returns one and performs no other work.

name: walk_string_then_finish
description: Steps through a string for up to the given count of characters, and if the zero terminator is reached calls a finishing routine. Returns without a value.

name: call_routine_and_return
description: Calls one other routine with no arguments and returns to its caller without a value.

name: copy_string_with_zero_padding
description: Copies characters from a source string into a fixed-size buffer until the zero terminator or the buffer size is reached, then fills the rest of the buffer with zero bytes.

name: return_at_once_no_op
description: Empty routine that returns at once without doing any work.

name: initialise_empty_list_header
description: Initialises an empty list header in the given block: the head points to the tail slot, the tail is cleared, and the tail predecessor points back to the head.

name: process_record_if_valid
description: Returns one for an empty request. Otherwise it runs a check on a fixed-size record and, if that passes, makes two calls and then processes a second record taken from a field of the block.

name: walk_node_list_checking_each
description: Walks a linked list of nodes, calling a check and then a second routine on each node, with a size taken from one byte field. Returns one when every node passes and zero at the first failure.

name: check_linked_nodes_in_sequence
description: Steps through a linked list of nodes, running two checks on each node. Returns one when the list ends with no failure, or zero at the first failed check.

name: stub_returns_zero_result
description: Returns zero and does nothing else.

name: allocate_and_link_record
description: Returns zero when the count argument is zero. Otherwise it allocates a cleared record, validates it, stores a value from a helper in one of its fields, and returns the record, or minus one if any step fails.

name: return_failure_minus_one
description: Returns minus one, a failure value, and does no other work.

name: build_record_chain
description: Builds a chain of cleared records, one per step of the requested count, linking each to the previous one through a pointer field and validating it. Returns the first record, zero for an empty request, or minus one if any step fails.

name: link_record_chain_until_end
description: Allocates records through helper routines, links each into a chain, and continues until the link field of the newest record is empty. Returns the first record, or minus one on failure.

name: fill_record_chain_from_stack
description: Allocates and links records in a loop driven by a value taken from the stack, with a check after each step. Returns the first record in the chain, or minus one if any step fails.

name: return_minus_one_value
description: Returns minus one and performs no other work.

name: create_and_add_library
description: Program entry for the translator library: it creates a library base with the exec MakeLibrary call, stores two values in it, and registers it with AddLibrary. Returns zero if creation fails, otherwise minus one.

name: increment_counter_clear_flag
description: Increments a 16-bit usage counter in the library base and clears bit five of a flags byte.

name: decrement_counter_and_maybe_finish
description: Decrements the 16-bit counter in the library base. When it reaches zero and bit five of the flags byte is set, it calls a finishing routine and returns that routine's result; otherwise it returns zero.

name: remove_node_or_mark_pending
description: If the node's count field is zero, unlinks the node from its list and calls a removal routine with a stored argument. Otherwise it sets bit five of the flags byte to mark the node pending and returns zero.

name: unlink_node_and_call_library
description: Unlinks a node from its list by joining its neighbours, then calls one library function and returns a value stored in the node.

name: parse_text_into_padded_buffer
description: Reads a text stream one character at a time into a 26-character buffer padded with spaces, handles hash-marked fields through helper routines, and returns the parsed result.

name: return_low_word_argument
description: Returns the low 16-bit word of the D0 register unchanged as the result.

name: clear_last_byte_return_word
description: Calls one routine, writes a zero byte just before the output pointer, and returns the 16-bit value left in the D1 register.

name: scan_translation_entries
description: Walks six-byte table entries, comparing input characters with each entry's text and calling helper routines. Stops at the end marker and returns a 16-bit status.

name: match_translation_entry_text
description: Compares input characters with the text of a table entry, using helper routines to advance through the entry. Returns a 16-bit status when the entry matches or the input ends.

name: skip_to_markup_delimiter
description: Reads characters up to a backslash or backtick delimiter and calls helper routines to check the text. Returns once the check passes or the input ends.

name: scan_delimited_text_items
description: Reads text character by character until a backslash or backtick, then calls helper routines for each delimited item and returns when the final check passes.

name: empty_return_routine
description: Empty routine that returns immediately without doing any work.

name: match_bracketed_text_prefix
description: Skips text up to an opening square bracket, then compares the following characters with a stored string until a closing bracket, and returns.

name: scan_backwards_with_char_table
description: Scans characters backwards through a text buffer, looking each one up in a character-class table, and calls a helper while the class flag is set. Returns when the buffer start is reached or the helper signals to stop.

name: return_no_op_stub
description: Empty routine that returns immediately without doing any work.

name: compare_backwards_through_table
description: Scans a text buffer backwards, checking each character against a character-class table and against a stored string. Returns when a mismatch or the buffer start is reached.

name: scan_to_equals_with_table
description: Reads characters until an equals sign, looking each one up in a character-class table and calling a helper for flagged characters. Returns when the sign or a mismatch is reached.

name: match_until_equals_sign
description: Compares input characters with a stored string until an equals sign, using a character-class table and a helper for flagged characters. Returns when the sign is found or the match fails.

name: copy_word_wrapped_text
description: Copies characters up to a backslash or backtick marker into an output buffer. When the text would overflow the remaining space it backs up to the last break-class character and ends the buffer there; otherwise it copies everything and returns the length copied.

name: copy_fixed_length_text_wrapped
description: Copies a fixed number of characters into the output buffer, backing up to a break-class character and ending the buffer there if the text would overflow. Returns the resulting length.

name: copy_counted_bytes
description: Copies a counted run of bytes to the destination, then updates a state flag from the byte that follows the run.

name: trim_trailing_break_characters
description: Moves backward from the end of the output over characters that have a class flag set, and writes a zero terminator at that position.

name: dispatch_by_special_character
description: Looks up a character in a twelve-entry table of special symbols and calls the handler routine stored at the matching position.

name: empty_return_routine
description: Empty routine that returns immediately without doing any work.

name: return_immediately_no_op
description: Empty routine that returns immediately without doing any work.

name: call_routine_and_return
description: Calls one other routine with no arguments and returns to its caller without a value.

name: repeat_call_while_flag_set
description: Calls one routine, then keeps calling it while bit five of a flags word is set, and returns without a value.

name: call_routine_and_return
description: Calls one other routine with no arguments and returns to its caller without a value.

name: check_flag_and_letter_code
description: Calls one routine, then if bit five of a flags word is set, calls another and compares the returned character with the letters I and E. Returns in every case without a value.

name: return_immediately_no_op
description: Empty routine that returns immediately without doing any work.

name: match_two_letter_suffix_codes
description: Reads characters through helper routines and compares them with fixed letters, following one of several letter sequences such as E then S or D, R, L then Y, or N then G. Returns when a letter fails to match or the sequence is complete.

name: match_ng_suffix
description: Checks that the next characters are the letters N and G, and when a flag bit is set also checks for the letter S, then returns.

name: return_immediately_no_op
description: Empty routine that returns immediately without doing any work.

name: call_routine_and_return
description: Calls one other routine with no arguments and returns to its caller without a value.

name: call_routine_and_return
description: Calls one other routine with no arguments and returns to its caller without a value.

name: call_routine_and_return
description: Calls one other routine with no arguments and returns to its caller without a value.

name: call_routine_and_return
description: Calls one other routine with no arguments and returns to its caller without a value.

name: repeat_call_while_flag_set
description: Calls one routine, then keeps calling it while bit five of a flags word is set, and returns without a value.

name: call_routine_and_return
description: Calls one other routine with no arguments and returns to its caller without a value.

name: repeat_call_while_bit_set
description: Calls one routine repeatedly for as long as bit two of a flags word is set, then returns without a value.

name: call_then_test_flag_bit
description: Calls one routine, then tests bit seven of a flags word and returns in either case without a value.

name: return_immediately_no_op
description: Empty routine that returns immediately without doing any work.

name: normalise_text_into_line_buffer
description: Copies input text into a line buffer one character at a time, replacing control characters and closing brackets with spaces and converting lower-case letters to upper-case. Stops at a double hash or after one hundred characters.

name: write_space_before_pointer
description: Writes a space character two bytes before the address held in the address register, then returns.

name: mark_vowel_pair_position
description: Scans the buffer for a letter with a special class flag, then compares the text with fourteen two-letter vowel pairs. On a match it inserts a marker character at that position, moving the following bytes up one place.

name: insert_marker_character
description: Opens a gap at a position in the buffer by moving the following bytes up one place, writes a fixed marker character into the gap, and updates the buffer end pointer.

name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: Stub that holds only an unimplemented instruction, so decoding stops here. The bytes are bad data rather than a working routine.

name: store_library_state
description: Stores the incoming register values in global variables, writes a pointer into a field of the structure passed in, and keeps that pointer in another global variable.

name: call_routine_and_return
description: Calls one other routine with no arguments and returns to its caller without a value.

name: call_routine_and_return
description: Calls one other routine with no arguments and returns to its caller without a value.

name: call_routine_and_return
description: Calls one other routine with no arguments and returns to its caller without a value.

name: return_immediately_no_op
description: Empty routine that returns immediately without doing any work.

name: call_routine_and_return
description: Calls one other routine with no arguments and returns to its caller without a value.

name: clear_flag_and_increment_counter
description: Clears bit three of a flags byte in the structure given as argument, increments the 16-bit counter in a later field, and returns the structure pointer.

name: release_block_or_mark_pending
description: If the counter field is zero, calls routines that unlink and release the block and returns the stored value. Otherwise it sets bit three of the flags byte, calls a routine, and returns zero.

name: save_global_and_call_helpers
description: Saves a global value, calls one library function, calls one routine with two arguments computed from fields of the structure, then calls another routine and returns the saved global value.

name: decrement_counter_release_flagged
description: Decrements the 16-bit counter in the structure. When it reaches zero and bit three of the flags byte is set, it calls a release routine and returns its result; otherwise it returns zero.

name: return_zero_no_op
description: Does nothing and returns zero.

name: release_nonnull_global_pointers
description: Calls a release routine on each of several global pointers and on the argument when it is non-zero, skipping null values, and returns without a value.

name: allocate_info_library_structure
description: Allocates a public, cleared block of 944 bytes, stores pointers to its sub-fields in global variables, copies template data into several of them, and sets up list links. Returns one on success and zero if the allocation fails.

name: initialise_info_structure_pointers
description: Computes pointers to the fields of a structure from its base address, stores them in global variables, copies template blocks into several of the fields, and returns one.

name: open_required_libraries
description: Opens three system libraries in sequence by name, keeping each base in a global variable. If an open fails it reports an error code of three, four or five through a routine and returns zero; returns one when all succeed.

name: open_libraries_via_pointers
description: Opens libraries through a function pointer, storing each base in a global variable. On failure it reports an error code of three, four or five through a second pointer and returns zero; returns one when all open.

name: open_intuition_and_second_library
description: Opens the intuition library and a second library through a function pointer, storing each base in a global. On failure it reports error code four or five and returns zero; returns one on success.

name: open_graphics_library
description: Opens the graphics library through a function pointer, stores its base in a global variable, and reports error code five if the open fails. Returns true when the library is open.

name: return_one_no_op
description: Returns one and performs no other work.

name: get_info_entry_value
description: Returns the value stored in a structure's field when it is set. Otherwise it follows a parent pointer, reads a field from the chosen structure, and returns it, or returns zero when the structure or the parent is missing.

name: get_info_value_from_pointer
description: Reads a value from the structure reached through the address-register pointer, using a stored field first and otherwise following a parent pointer. Returns zero when nothing is found.

name: get_info_value_or_default
description: Returns a stored value from the structure if one is present, otherwise reads it from a parent structure or returns zero.

name: read_info_field_from_parent
description: Reads a value from a structure's parent when a flag byte is one, otherwise from a supplied pointer, and returns zero when no pointer is available.

name: read_nested_info_value
description: Returns a value read through two pointers: a field of the structure in the address register and a field of the structure it points to. Returns zero when the first pointer is null.

name: read_disk_info_entry
description: Reads a disk information entry into a temporary 116-byte buffer, using either a global name or a name held in the structure, and returns the value. Stores the result pointer in a field and sets a status flag.

name: lookup_info_with_status_flag
description: Looks up an entry in the structure's stored table using a temporary buffer, clears a status flag, and returns the found value while setting the flag when the entry is valid.

name: allocate_info_entry_blocks
description: Allocates two cleared blocks of 36 and 260 bytes, validates them, allocates a third block of at least 256 bytes sized from a counter, copies data into it, and returns one on success or zero if any step fails.

name: fill_info_entry_from_pointers
description: Fills in an info entry from the supplied pointers: it computes a size, checks the entries, allocates a further block, copies data into it, and returns one on success or zero on failure.

name: complete_info_entry_setup
description: Completes setup of an info entry by copying data, storing a size of at least 256, and allocating a further block. Returns one on success and zero on failure.

name: finish_info_entry_allocation
description: Finishes an info entry by copying data, storing a size of at least 256, and allocating a further block. Returns one on success and zero on failure.

name: setup_info_entry_return_flag
description: Performs the info-entry setup steps, copying data, computing a size of at least 256, allocating a block and recording its fields, and returns true when the allocation succeeded.

name: copy_info_entry_fields
description: Copies data from one structure into another, then copies two word-sized fields from the source structures and returns one.

name: build_info_entry_reporting_errors
description: Clears its globals, then allocates a 246-byte public cleared block, checks and fills several sub-structures, and reports failure codes five, six, seven or one through a routine when a step fails.

name: build_info_entry_via_callback
description: Builds an info entry like its neighbour, allocating a 246-byte cleared block and filling sub-structures, and reports failure codes through a function pointer when a step fails.

name: validate_and_fill_info_entry
description: Checks and fills an info entry from a supplied structure, copying data between sub-structures and reporting error codes five or seven through a pointer when a step fails.

name: fill_info_entry_from_global
description: Looks up an info entry, copies its data into a supplied structure, and reports error codes five or seven through a pointer when a step fails.

name: fill_info_entry_fields
description: Copies a global entry into the supplied structure, then performs four copy steps, and reports error seven through a pointer when the lookup fails.

name: finish_info_entry_copy
description: Copies data into the entry, runs a check and four follow-up steps when the check passes, and reports status zero on success or one on failure through a pointer.

name: report_info_entry_status
description: Runs a check and, if it passes, copies data and performs four follow-up steps. Reports status zero on success or one on failure through a pointer.

name: run_steps_call_library
description: Optionally runs a helper when a flag is set and the argument is non-zero, runs four helper routines, then calls a library function with zero and the stack argument, and returns.

name: invoke_library_jump_entry
description: Calls a function through a jump-table entry of the library whose base is kept in a global variable, passing no arguments, then returns.

name: invoke_library_jump_entry
description: Calls a function through a jump-table entry of the library whose base is kept in a global variable, passing no arguments, then returns.

description: Calls a function through a jump-table entry of a second library whose base pointer is kept in a global variable, passing no arguments, then returns.

name: create_info_with_fixed_parameters
description: Fills a stack-allocated parameter block with fixed size, position and flag values, passes it to a routine that creates an object, and if that succeeds passes the result to a second routine. Returns the result.

name: dispatch_info_state_action
description: Dispatches on a state code stored in a structure, calling a helper with stored values for each case. Returns one for most states and zero for two of them.

name: return_one_no_op
description: Returns one and performs no other work.

name: toggle_info_flag_bit
description: Maps a type code to one of several bit values, toggles that bit in a stored flags word, and calls a helper with a field of the structure. Unlisted types leave the flags unchanged but still call the helper.

name: store_flags_and_call_helper
description: Stores the value in the data register into a stored flags field, then calls a helper with a pointer taken from the structure.

name: build_and_check_icon_file
description: Formats an icon file name with the info extension in a 40-byte stack buffer, checks or creates the file through library calls, and returns whether it is usable.

name: check_disk_info_fields
description: Checks disk-related fields of a structure through helper routines, clears the result when any check fails, and returns the result after applying a mask to one stored field.

name: check_info_file_attributes
description: Copies a name into a stack buffer, checks the structure's fields through library calls and helper routines, and returns zero if any check fails, otherwise one.

name: check_three_info_entries
description: Calls three helper routines to test four stored entries against a sentinel value. Returns zero if any entry is missing, otherwise calls a helper and returns one.

name: check_three_indirect_results
description: Calls one function pointer three times, returning zero if any result equals minus one. Otherwise calls a helper and returns one.

name: check_two_indirect_results
description: Calls one function pointer twice, returning zero if either result equals minus one. Otherwise calls a helper and returns one.

name: call_indirect_and_report_success
description: Calls a function through a pointer and, if the result is not minus one, calls a helper. Returns true when the result was not minus one.

name: call_other_and_return_one
description: Calls one other routine and then returns one.

name: initialise_info_field_table
description: Registers a long list of field entries by calling a helper with constant range values, using the text labels NAME, STATUS and TYPE, then returns.

name: register_info_range_entries
description: Calls one helper seven times with a fixed first argument and constant ranges, registering a set of entries.

name: register_second_info_range_set
description: Calls one helper seven times with a fixed first argument and constant ranges, registering a second set of entries.

name: register_info_entry_group
description: Calls one helper nine times with a fixed first argument and constant ranges to register a group of entries.

name: register_remaining_info_entries
description: Calls one helper nine times with a fixed first argument and constant ranges to register another group of entries.

name: setup_entry_from_state_size
description: Chooses a size value from a state byte, then either calls helpers to set up an empty entry or passes the value and a list field to a helper. Calls a further helper when the second argument is non-zero.

name: finish_list_update_and_notify
description: Calls one routine when a list is empty and another with a field of the structure otherwise, then calls a further routine with a stored pointer when a flag argument is non-zero.

name: notify_entry_and_optional_pointer
description: Calls one routine, passes a field of the structure to a second routine, and calls a third with a stored pointer when a flag argument is non-zero.

name: allocate_list_header_and_entries
description: Allocates a 14-byte cleared list header and links it to itself, then walks a NULL-terminated table allocating a 128-byte cleared entry for each item and linking it into the list. Returns the last result, or zero if an allocation fails.

name: add_table_entries_to_list
description: Links the list header to itself, then walks a NULL-terminated table allocating a 128-byte entry for each item and adding it to the list. Stops without a value if an allocation fails.

name: build_list_from_table_items
description: Walks a NULL-terminated table, creating and linking one list entry per item through helper routines. Records the first entry and returns the last value, or zero if creation fails.

name: append_list_entries_from_table
description: Walks a NULL-terminated table and appends one entry per item to the list through helper routines. Returns the final value, or zero if an entry cannot be created.

name: step_list_cursor_and_notify
description: Either notifies the end of the list and calls two helpers with the structure's fields, or moves the list cursor to the next entry and calls helpers for that entry.

name: advance_list_cursor_and_notify
description: Passes the current list entry's field to a helper, calls another routine, advances the list cursor to the next entry, and calls a final routine.

name: step_list_cursor_back
description: Either notifies the end of the list and calls helpers, or passes the current entry to a helper and moves the list cursor backwards to the entry linked from its first word.

name: move_cursor_to_first_link
description: Passes the current list entry's field to a helper, moves the list cursor to the entry linked from its first word, and calls a final routine.

name: insert_new_list_entry
description: Sets a state flag, optionally calls two helpers when the list has entries, allocates a 14-byte header and a 128-byte cleared block for it, links the new entry into the list, and calls a final routine.

name: remove_list_entry_and_relink
description: Sets a flag and either notifies an empty list or passes the current entry to helpers, selects a neighbouring entry, moves the list cursor onto it, and calls a final routine.

name: advance_list_cursor_by_link
description: Calls a helper with the current cursor's link, moves the cursor onto that link or onto the list head at the end, and calls a final routine.

name: call_two_entry_fields
description: Calls one routine, then calls a second routine with one field of the structure and a third with another field.

name: allocate_entry_pointer_array
description: When a flag is set, counts the list entries, allocates a cleared array with one pointer slot per entry, then allocates a block for each entry and stores its pointer in the array. Returns one on success and zero if an allocation fails.

name: build_entry_pointer_array
description: Counts the list entries, allocates a cleared array with one pointer slot per entry, and fills each slot with a newly allocated block copied from the entry. Returns one on success or zero when an allocation fails.

name: build_entry_pointer_array_checked
description: Counts the list entries, allocates a cleared pointer array, and fills each slot with a newly allocated block copied from the entry. Returns one on success or zero when an allocation fails.

name: create_entry_pointer_array
description: Counts the list entries, allocates a cleared pointer array with one slot per entry, and stores a copied block for each entry in its slot. Returns one on success or zero when an allocation fails.

name: fill_entry_pointer_array_slots
description: Copies the array pointer, then allocates a block for each remaining list entry, storing each block's pointer in the array and copying data into it. Returns one on success or zero if an allocation fails.

name: fill_remaining_entry_slots
description: Walks the remaining list entries, allocating a block for each, storing its pointer and copying the entry data into it. Returns one when the list is done or zero if an allocation fails.
